title: Cardinal DriveSense Desk Reference Card — Activation, Observation and Data Gap Periods
content:
Period lengths and minimums for Cardinal DriveSense, by program. Day counts are calendar days unless stated otherwise.

| Program | Activation window: days after enrollment within which the app or device must report a first trip | Observation period: days from the first trip | Active days needed in the observation period for a score | Trips needed in the observation period for a score | Consecutive days of no data from the device or app after which observation is terminated |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Cardinal DriveSense Mobile | 14 | 90 | 45 | 60 | 21 |
| Cardinal DriveSense Plug-In | 21 | 120 | 60 | 80 | 14 |
| Cardinal DriveSense Connected Car | 14 | 120 | 60 | 80 | 30 |
| Cardinal DriveSense Teen Coach | 14 | 180 | 75 | 100 | 21 |
| Cardinal DriveSense Miles Mobile | 14 | 0 (no observation period) | 0 | 0 | 30 |
| Cardinal DriveSense Miles Plug-In | 21 | 0 (no observation period) | 0 | 0 | 14 |

## Terms used on this card

- **Active day** — a day with at least one trip.
- **Activation window** — counted from the enrollment date. The two plug-in programs allow 21 days; every other program allows 14.
- **Observation period** — counted from the date of the first trip. The pay-per-mile programs (Miles Mobile and Miles Plug-In) have no observation period and no active-day or trip minimum: their first trip starts mileage tracking.
- **No-data period** — counted in consecutive days with no data from the device or the app.

## Comparisons across programs (figures from the card)

| Program | Share of the observation period that must be active days |
|---|---|
| Cardinal DriveSense Mobile | 45 of 90 days |
| Cardinal DriveSense Plug-In | 60 of 120 days |
| Cardinal DriveSense Connected Car | 60 of 120 days |
| Cardinal DriveSense Teen Coach | 75 of 180 days |

- The longest no-data period on the card is 30 consecutive days (Connected Car, Miles Mobile); the shortest is 14 (Plug-In, Miles Plug-In).
- Hypothetical reading: a Plug-In vehicle with 62 active days and 78 trips in its observation period has met the active-day figure (60) and not the trip figure (80); a Mobile vehicle with 50 active days and 64 trips has met both figures (45 and 60).
